newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving up in selective trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving up in selective trading.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may extend gains on selective blue chip buying when the market reopens after the Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
"Share prices are likely to rise as there will be buying pressure from the small investors," said broker Khurshid Alam.

Broker Sabbir Ahmed said: "The market will move higher as the demand is not satiated. The supply of shares is not enough to meet the huge demand from small investors." Brokers said blue chips like Beximco Pharma, Meghna Cement and Eastern Housing could rise.
The DSE benchmark index closed 59.74 points or 3.46 percent up at 1,786.27 on a turnover of 194.1 million taka on Thursday.
